Update November 26, 2026: AirPods Pro 3 are still in stock after selling out. They’ve dropped down to their new all-time low price of $149.

Happy Thanksgiving! Apple’s AirPods Pro 3 have now dropped even lower for Black Friday, with an incredible $100 discount to $149 shipped – their best price ever. We’re also tracking deals on Apple’s brand new OLED iPad mini, the 2026 AirPods Max 2 down again at $130 off, even deeper discounts on the current-generation Apple Watch SE 3 from $179, up to $400 off MacBook Air, and now, an even lower price on the world’s greatest buds.

The best Black Friday Apple deals live right now:

  • AirPods Pro 3 $149 (Reg. $249) – Now even lower
  • Apple Watch Series 12 from $299 (Reg. $399) – All-time low
  • M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB Up to $400 off
  • MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (Reg. $700) – Now even lower
  • New OLED iPad mini (A20 Pro) $599 (Reg. $699) – All-time low
  • Apple Pencil (USB-C) $49 (Reg. $79)
  • 1-pack AirTag 2 $18 (Reg. $29)
  • 2026 Apple Polishing Cloth $9 Prime shipped (Back in-stock)

AirPods Pro 3: Best Black Friday deal

Amazon kicked off this year’s massive Black Friday event with a notable discount at $180 for AirPods Pro 3, down from the regular $249 list price. However, as we push deeper into the sale, it has now dropped the price again down to $149 shipped.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $169$149 (Reg. $249) – Best price ever
  • AirPods Max 2 $419 (Reg. $549) – $130 off
  • Beats 360 Wireless Over-Ear Headphones $249 (Reg. $349) – All-time low

This is a new Amazon all-time low and the best price ever. It’s a bigger drop than we were expecting. When they dropped to $169 yesterday, we weren’t sure if they’d go even lower — let alone this much lower.

As we recently noted in our AirPods buying guide, AirPods Pro 3 remain Apple’s most capable and feature-rich buds. Delivering a proper sealed in-ear fit, they land under the tree this year with 3x better noise cancellation than the new entry-level AirPods 5, alongside a far more advanced health and wellness experience centered around the built-in heart rate sensor (as well as the Hearing Test, Hearing Aid, and Hearing Protection features.

We are still awaiting a potential discount on the 2026 AirPods 5, but with all of that said, it’s not going to make much sense for most folks to opt for the less powerful AirPods 5 over the Pro set at this point – unless you specifically prefer the more open-ear experience, you can score the far more powerful AirPods Pro 3 for the same price as the Wireless Charging Case AirPods 5 config right now.
